storeInfo.name: Koto Japanese Steak House and Sushi Bar
storeInfo.tagline: Amazing Hibachi and Fresh Sushi in Groton, CT | Hibachi increíble y sushi fresco

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento privado disponible en el lote del restaurante.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Private parking available in the restaurant lot.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Soyas verdes tiernas al vapor, ligeramente saladas con sal marina.
products.descriptionEn: Tender young green soybeans steamed and lightly salted with sea salt.

products.descriptionEs: Empanadas doradas a la sartén rellenas de cerdo jugoso y vegetales, servidas con salsa ponzu.
products.descriptionEn: Pan-seared golden dumplings filled with juicy pork and vegetables, served with savory ponzu dipping sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Camarones frescos y crujientes envueltos en un rebozado ligero al estilo tempura con vegetales.
products.descriptionEn: Fresh and crispy lightly battered jumbo shrimp and assorted vegetables fried to golden perfection.

products.descriptionEs: Finos cortes de atún ligeramente sellados a la sartén con costra de sésamo, servidos con salsa ponzu cítrica.
products.descriptionEn: Seared rare sliced tuna with sesame crust, served with tangy citrus ponzu sauce and scallions.

products.descriptionEs: Rollo de tempura de camarón y pepino, cubierto con atún fresco picante, aguacate y salsa especial del chef.
products.descriptionEn: Shrimp tempura and cucumber roll topped with spicy tuna, sliced avocado, and house special eel sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Rollo clásico de California cubierto con una colorida variedad de pescado fresco y aguacate.
products.descriptionEn: Classic California roll wrapped with an array of fresh raw fish varieties and creamy avocado.

products.descriptionEs: Cola de langosta tempura, aguacate, pepino y totopos de lechuga con salsa de mango dulce.
products.descriptionEn: Crispy lobster tail tempura, avocado, cucumber, and crisp lettuce drizzled with sweet mango chili sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Tierno filete mignon cocinado a la plancha hibachi con vegetales frescos, arroz frito y sopa de miso.
products.descriptionEn: Tender filet mignon grilled to perfection on our hibachi tables, served with hibachi vegetables, fried rice, and soup.

products.nameEs: Disfruta de una combinación jugosa de pollo tierno y camarones jugosos preparados frente a ti.
products.descriptionEn: Juicy chicken breast paired with succulent jumbo shrimp cooked hibachi style with fried rice and noodles.
Crispy golden tofu cubes sautéed with a seasonal medley of fresh garden vegetables on our hibachi grill.
Chef's daily selection of 9 exquisite pieces of fresh nigiri sushi and a classic spicy tuna roll.
Refreshing and soothing Japanese green tea, served chilled over ice.
Traditional Japanese carbonated soft drink with a unique marble stopper and crisp citrus flavor.
Classic brewed Japanese rice wine, smoothly textured and served either warm or chilled.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones de vegetales, tofu y rollos especiales sin gluten. Por favor informe a su mesero sobre cualquier alergia.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetable, tofu dishes, and customizable rolls. Please inform your server of any severe allergies.

faqs.qEs: ¿Se requiere reservación para el área de Hibachi?
faqs.qEn: Are reservations required for the Hibachi tables?
faqs.aEs: No son obligatorias, pero son muy recomendadas especialmente los fines de semana debido a la alta demanda.
faqs.aEn: Reservations are not strictly required, but strongly recommended especially on weekends due to high demand.

faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con estacionamiento privado gratuito justo al lado del restaurante para todos nuestros clientes.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have free private parking available right next to the restaurant for all our dining guests.
